## Current continuation — complete three-leaf C5 and uniform nonparallel-roof reductions (October 29, 2026 UTC)

Published in [`875da3f`](https://github.com/vltanh/lean4-squares-in-circles/commit/875da3f02f816be16aaf1e2127eba17191052fa6). The unrestricted sharp theorem, equality classification and global prerequisite audit remain **OPEN**.

- **Complete simple C5 with three distinct genuine leaves:** both original cyclic spacings are now excluded, including the full consecutive-root parallel and nonparallel cases. The arbitrary ninth square, every original positive force, physical circle mask and closed shared mean interval are retained. The five remaining direct-leaf root families are the house ADT/ADB/ABC and fan H12/H23 cases.
- **Uniform roof reductions:** the common-original-application free/shared hub cases and the entire unique-circle free/shared return domain now have complete proofs and independent reviews. Their finite dense restrictions are imposed together before stress extraction inside the same earlier nonempty open genuine domain. The resulting unique-circle owner cover retains all four owned roof types, full hub/exterior stars and all three completion squares. This conditional local selection argument does not replace the global prerequisite audit.
- **Physical two-corner roofs:** transverse ports are excluded without the new selections; the two exact inner-face charts, including individual zero circle coefficients, remain open.

The checkpoint contains **10 complete mathematical sources, 11 full independent reviews, 162 matching named source-pin occurrences and 27 exact rational comparisons**. The 28-path immutable publication was checked against its parent, with no extra paths or deletions. All five metadata edits reverse exactly to their prior hashes apart from the explicitly documented current prose.

**Original inventory is unchanged:** **2373/2513** fine flags checked (**140 open**), **36/58** coarse rows closed (**22 open**). No original parent is checked by these subfeature results. Hand proofs only; no Lean/Lake build, CI or workflow dispatch, numerical pose search, new packing certificate or merge.
